measurement: Native Docker State.StartedAt/FinishedAt read through daemon console API; preparation from transfer phase records
interpretation: Full-workspace preparation dominates these final stages, not the image command.
Micro fan-in merge and compression/upload consume substantial time; no isolated bandwidth benchmark was performed.
Destination single-pass verification and reserved SSH control capacity were implemented after these measurements, not active during v5.
Synchronous idle cloud stop waits delayed observation; AKO-117 was implemented after v5 and is not validated by these measurements.
Run metrics include recoveries and delayed observation, so aggregate compute is not pure command time.

corrections.change: Eight parallel predecessor routes per consumer
Safe Terraform stop/start updates without create/delete/replace
Stop failed configuration only when a physical provider instance exists
Bind workspace SSH to exact verified instance generation
Deduplicate queued infrastructure and reconcile unused operations
Serialize runtime control per handle; protect observation cancellation
Compressed full-workspace archives with integrity verification
Ready exact preserved stopped producer before recovery inspection
Isolate Docker telemetry by actual recovery attempt
Verify unique destination paths once after merge
Reserve one SSH control channel from bulk transfer saturation
Independent bounded idle cloud stop progress
